answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 9569 Country: India Title: If anybody sucks milk of his wife intentionally or unintentionally, will their marriage be nullified? Question: If anybody sucks milk of his wife intentionally or unintentionally, will their marriage be nullified? Answer ID: 9569 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2510/2064=B/1429) The Nikah is not nullified by sucking the breast of wife, but it is unlawful to drink the milk, one must refrainn from it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
